name: terrapalus-updated
title: Terra Palus (2.1)
author: Lukah, updated by Alex Green
description:
Adds a new hybrid planet combining features of Nauvis and Gleba. Brave the dangerous swamp moon of Terra Palus; mine Palusium ore and use UV light to freeze those that would see you destroyed.
Terra Palus by Lukah, updated for Factorio 2.1. Prototype and setting names are unchanged, so a save with the original mod can switch to this one.
